build_retriever_subclass: build a subclass of BaseRetriever that implements forward and matching methods for prototype retrieval
implement_extract_feat: implement the extract_feat method in a BaseRetriever subclass to extract features from backbone and neck
implement_loss: implement the loss method in a BaseRetriever subclass to calculate losses from inputs and data samples
implement_predict: implement the predict method in a BaseRetriever subclass to return predictions from extracted features
implement_dump_prototype: implement the dump_prototype method in a BaseRetriever subclass to save extracted features to a file path
